title: Old Synagogue (Essen)
geometryBasis: The standing synagogue matches native named way 56149749 and Q316542. Körner’s original sections and elevations set the exterior architecture, including both side projections and the lower entrance.
sectionBasis: The original 1914 measured Steeler Tor, Steeler Straße, Alfredistraße and rear elevations establish the ashlar façade around the 34 m dome, double rows of molded cornices, four domed towers and the graduated portal. Essen’s survey specifies prepatinated copper and limestone in the ongoing repairs.
limitations: Represents the permanent restored form documented by the city. Temporary construction scaffolding, the removed outer forecourt arcade, the separate rabbi’s house, and interior exhibits are outside the building model.
Masses, openings and architectural hierarchy follow the original elevations and native surveyed outline. Individual ashlar joints and fine tracery are representative.
